title: API database password typo
reason: All three aspects correctly identify the API, the faulty deploy, and the password typo as cause.
root_cause: The API container was upgraded to version 2.3.2, which contains an incorrect database password setting, causing repeated authentication failures against PostgreSQL.
truth: api 2.3.2 was deployed with a typo in the DATABASE_PASSWORD environment variable, so the application cannot authenticate to PostgreSQL.
